uncovered_shapes.sentence: An audit of 288 responses showed overall F1 of 0.916, yet prompt-specific scorer errors ranged from 2.6 percent to 33.3 percent, and an apparent 9.3-point increase from asserting certainty fell to 2.3 points under both raters.

claims.claim: Kolibri has 78.1 billion total parameters and 3.46 billion active parameters per token.
claims.episode_span: Kolibri is a new English-German mixture-of-experts transformer with 78.1 billion total parameters and 3.46 billion active parameters per token.
claims.source_title: Kolibri: A Sovereign European Model on the Pareto Frontier
claims.supporting_quote: This report introduces Kolibri, an English-German mixture-of-experts transformer with 78.1B total parameters and 3.46B active parameters per token, released as open weights under the Apache 2.0 licence.

claims.claim: AKV cuts average cost 27.7 percent across four agent benchmarks.
claims.episode_span: Tsinghua released AKV, an SGLang-based cache engineering server that lets LLM agents drop and reposition KV cache instead of summarizing history, cutting average cost 27.7 percent across four agent benchmarks.
claims.source_title: Tsinghua AI Open-Sources AKV, a Cache Engineering Server for LLM Agents on SGLang
claims.supporting_quote: LLM agents drop and reposition KV cache instead of summarizing history, cutting average cost 27.7% across 4 agent benchmarks.

claims.claim: SPECMEM delivers up to 1.74x wall-clock speedup and a 27 percent gap in mean accepted tokens.
claims.episode_span: SPECMEM keeps a live per-user tool-call memory with LRU eviction and side-effect gating, delivering a 27 percent gap in accepted tokens and up to 1.74x wall-clock speedup on multi-session streams.
claims.source_title: SPECMEM: Accelerating Agentic Tool Calling via Live Memory Management
claims.supporting_quote: a 27% gap in mean accepted tokens (+11% to +34% across benchmarks, tracking how much novel work arrives after the store is built) and up to 1.74x wall-clock speedup.

claims.supporting_quote: an external model trained solely on a policy's behavioral traces can estimate the policy's confidence as accurately as the policy itself, without accessing the policy's internal representations

claims.supporting_quote: verified calls are written back online into bounded per-user stores with LRU eviction, and a side-effect gate defers irreversible calls until verification confirms
